He is now basically demanding that MITER open up all their records regarding involvement with this sort of subject.
tellings.difference: Told by the host rather than by Burlison firsthand, and names only MITRE, not RAND or MIT Lincoln Labs.
tellings.link_reason: Both are Rep. Burlison's 2026 demand that MITRE open its UAP-related records, made through letters.

as_told.title: Rep. Burlison demands MITRE's UAP records

plain: Eric Burlison, a US congressman, says that in 2026 he has been sending letters to MITRE, RAND and MIT Lincoln Laboratory, private research groups that do science and defense work for the US government. He mentions this while talking about the government's release of UFO files, and he means that he is pressing these groups for whatever they know about the subject.
